label: Molecular-sieve dehydration with heat integration
description: Pressure-swing sieves plus heat integration replace azeotropic distillation.

label: Anaerobic digester (component)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Digests manure, crop residues or organic waste to raw biogas.
note: A component: priced only to assemble whole-plant costs with an upgrader (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or an engine (anaerobic-digester_chp) from the same source. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-24.

label: Anaerobic digestion with upgrading
description: Digests organic feed to biogas and upgrades it to pipeline-quality gas.
examples-named: RNG plants on landfills and digesters

label: Methanol recovery with heat integration
description: Recovers and recycles methanol with column heat integration or vapour recompression.

label: Distillers-grain drying with heat recovery or heat pumps
description: Recovers dryer exhaust heat, or uses a heat pump, on the largest gas load in the plant.

label: Ethanol fermenter with capture of the fermentation CO2
description: An ethanol fermenter whose off-gas, about 99% CO2, is sent to capture instead of venting it. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Biogenic, so it is a removal. The distillation and drying heat is unchanged and still comes from the heat bands. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Grain dry-mill fermentation and distillation
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; doe_2015_004; etsap_2013_011
description: Mills, cooks and ferments starch, then distils and dehydrates the beer and dries the stillage.

label: Lignocellulosic enzymatic fermentation
description: Pretreats and enzymatically hydrolyzes biomass before fermentation.

label: Syngas fermentation
description: Microbes convert gasified biomass or waste gas to ethanol.

label: Biomass gasification with methanation
sources: van der Meijden et al 2011; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Gasifies solid biomass and methanates the syngas to pipeline-quality gas.

label: Gasification with Fischer-Tropsch synthesis
description: Gasifies biomass or waste and synthesizes liquid hydrocarbons.

label: Landfill gas recovery and upgrading
description: Collects landfill gas and upgrades it to pipeline specification.

label: Alcohol-to-jet
description: Dehydrates and oligomerizes ethanol or isobutanol to jet fuel.

label: Hydrothermal liquefaction
description: Converts wet biomass to bio-crude in hot pressurized water, then upgrades it.

label: Hydrotreating of oils and fats (HEFA/HVO)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_011
description: Hydrodeoxygenates and isomerizes lipids to diesel and jet range fuels.

label: Methanol-to-jet
description: Converts methanol, including e-methanol, to jet fuel.

label: Pyrolysis oil upgrading
description: Fast pyrolysis of biomass then hydroprocessing of the oil.

label: Biogas upgrader (component)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Removes CO2 and impurities from biogas or landfill gas by water scrubbing, amine, pressure swing adsorption, membranes or organic solvent.
note: The upgrader alone; anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading is digester and upgrader together. Methane slip differs by technology (0.04% amine to 0.5-20% membrane). Added 2026-09-23. Made a component 2026-09-24: an upgrader delivers RNG only with a digester (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or landfill gas (process-improvement_landfill-gas-recovery) behind it, so it serves no hierarchy node.

label: Alkali-catalyzed transesterification
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; LVOC BREF 2017; etsap_2013_011
description: Reacts oils or fats with methanol over a homogeneous catalyst to fatty acid methyl esters.

label: Heterogeneous-catalyst transesterification
description: Solid catalyst avoids the washing and neutralization steps and gives cleaner glycerin.

label: Alkali-activated binder
sources: UKERC 2013; Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; IEA-CSI 2018; ETSAP I03; Worrell 2013
description: Geopolymer binder from slag or ash with an alkali activator, without clinker.

label: Blended cement with supplementary cementitious materials
sources: Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; IEA-CSI 2018; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; Cancio Díaz 2017; Sánchez Berriel 2016; Schneider 2015
description: Replaces clinker with slag, fly ash or ground limestone.

label: Calcined clay cement (LC3)
sources: Habert et al 2020; CSI-ECRA 2017; IEA-CSI 2018; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; Cancio Díaz 2017; Sánchez Berriel 2016
description: Clay calcined at about 800 degC replaces part of the clinker.

label: Carbonated binder
sources: Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018
description: Calcium silicate binder cured with CO2 rather than water.

label: Electrochemical cement from calcium silicates (Sublime)
description: Electrolysis at ambient temperature extracts calcium from non-carbonate calcium silicates and makes a cementitious binder without a kiln, so there is no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Sublime Systems route (MIT spin-out of Ellis et al. 2019); the IEA guide row on electrolytic limestone decarbonation ahead of a kiln is a different route and is not mapped here. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Hydrothermal calcium hydrosilicate binder
sources: UKERC 2013; Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018; Schneider 2015
description: Binder made in an autoclave and ground, with no rotary kiln (e.g. Celitement).
note: Rests on one source value. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Calcium sulphoaluminate clinker
sources: UKERC 2013; Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018; Worrell 2013; Schneider 2015
description: Clinker based on ye'elimite, fired at about 1250 degC with less limestone.
note: Process CO2 20-50% below Portland clinker. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Electrified or indirectly heated calciner
sources: Bataille 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018; Kearns 2021; ETSAP I03; Material Economics 2019
description: Calcines the meal with electric heat or an indirectly heated vessel, separating process CO2 from flue gas.

label: Ball mill
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA-CSI 2018; Worrell 2013; Schneider 2015; doe_2017_002
description: Tumbling mill grinding clinker and additions to cement fineness.

label: Vertical roller mill or high-pressure grinding rolls
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; CSI-ECRA 2017; IEA-CSI 2018; ETSAP I03; Worrell 2013; Schneider 2015; doe_2017_002
description: Bed comminution in place of impact grinding, at much lower specific power.
note: Merged grinding-mill_high-pressure-rolls (High-pressure grinding rolls) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Cement kiln with integrated calcium looping
description: Calciner and preheater rebuilt so the kiln concentrates its own CO2 with a CaO sorbent loop; more fuel, power export.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Portland clinker from calcium-silicate rock (Brimstone)
description: Dissolves calcium-silicate rock instead of limestone and fires the recovered calcium to ordinary Portland clinker, co-producing a supplementary cementitious material and magnesium; no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Dry rotary kiln with preheater and precalciner
carriers: municipal-waste; hydrogen; coal; petroleum-coke; natural-gas; biomass
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Habert et al 2020; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; CLM BREF 2013; Voldsund 2019; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; ETSAP I03; Material Economics 2019; Worrell 2013; Sánchez Berriel 2016; Schneider 2015; doe_2017_002
description: Multi-stage cyclone preheater and precalciner ahead of a short rotary kiln, with a grate cooler.
examples-named: Fluidized-bed kiln; Flash or fluid-bed calciner
note: Merged kiln_fluidized-bed (Fluidized-bed kiln) 2026-10-02 [C29, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type alternative, trl 6-7, product-unit t. Merged calciner_flash-fluid (Flash or fluid-bed calciner) 2026-10-02 [C30, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Cement kiln with post-combustion capture
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IPCC 2022; CSI-ECRA 2017; Voldsund 2019; IEA-CSI 2018; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; ETSAP I03; Schneider 2015; etsap_2010_007

description: A cement kiln whose stack gas, carrying process and combustion CO2 together, is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. The regeneration steam is large enough that the plant needs a heat source of its own, which is the host-side fact this row carries. Oxy-fuel and direct-separation kilns concentrate the stream instead and are their own rows. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Cement kiln efficiency measures, moderate
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Lehne and Preston 2018; CSI-ECRA 2017; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; Material Economics 2019
description: Combustion and sealing measures on an existing kiln line.
examples-named: burner and combustion control; reduced false air; kiln shell insulation
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Cement kiln efficiency measures, strong
description: The preheater, cooler and gas-path upgrades that together take a kiln line well below its current fuel use.
examples-named: extra preheater stages; high-efficiency grate cooler; low-pressure-drop gas path
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Legacy cement kiln (wet, semi-dry or long dry)
sources: CSI-ECRA 2017; CLM BREF 2013; ETSAP I03; Worrell 2013; Sánchez Berriel 2016; doe_2017_002
description: Wet, semi-wet, semi-dry (Lepol grate) and long dry rotary kilns: routes older than the preheater-precalciner kiln, using more than 15% more fuel per t clinker.
examples-named: wet, semi-wet, Lepol, wet-precalciner and long dry kilns (ETSAP I03)
note: Still operating in Canada after 2000: two wet kilns in 1999 (NRCan cement benchmark guide, 2001); the 2014 MSAPR RIAS lists wet and long dry kilns among Canada's kiln types.

label: Oxy-fuel kiln
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; CSI-ECRA 2017; Voldsund 2019; Agora Energiewende 2021; IEA-CSI 2018; ETSAP I03; Material Economics 2019; Schneider 2015
description: Fires on oxygen and recycled flue gas, so the kiln gas is CO2-rich.
note: Oxy-firing concentrates the kiln gas, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated and is not repeated here; the air separation unit is the host-side cost.

label: Autothermal reforming with full capture
description: An oxygen-blown autothermal reformer designed to send nearly all its CO2, in one concentrated stream, to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: The oxygen-blown route gives one concentrated stream, held on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated; there is no dilute flue gas to treat separately. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Fired heater and distillation train
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; LVOC BREF 2017; doe_2015_004
description: Reboilers and fired heaters driving separation columns.

label: Heat-integrated, progressive or divided-wall distillation
sources: UKERC 2013; Boulamanti 2017; stuckrath 2022; Worrell 2015; Kiss et al 2012; doe_2015_004
description: Column internals and heat integration cutting reboiler duty against a conventional train.
note: Merged distillation-column_progressive (Progressive or divided-wall distillation) 2026-09-23; it had family petroleum-refining, trl 8.

label: Heat-pumped distillation
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Kiss 2017; stuckrath 2022; Kiss et al 2012
description: Vapour recompression or a closed-cycle heat pump replaces the reboiler steam.
note: Merged vapour-recompressor_distillation (Distillation with mechanical vapour recompression) 2026-10-02 [C11, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Diaphragm chlor-alkali cell
description: Diaphragm cell producing weak caustic that needs steam evaporation; legacy North American stock.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Membrane chlor-alkali cell
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; Saygin 2011; Chlor-alkali BREF 2014; van 2025
description: Ion-exchange membrane cell producing chlorine, caustic soda and hydrogen.

label: Oxygen-depolarized cathode cell
description: Feeds oxygen to the cathode, cutting cell voltage and power use, with no hydrogen co-product.

label: Sodium chlorate cell
description: Electrolytic cell making sodium chlorate for pulp bleaching.

label: Thermal or catalytic oxidiser
description: Oxidises VOC-laden vent gas with support fuel; straight, recuperative, regenerative (90-97% heat recovery) or catalytic (300-500 degC).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Merged gas-treatment-unit_regenerative-oxidiser (Regenerative thermal oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3. Merged gas-treatment-unit_catalytic-oxidiser (Catalytic oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3.

label: Biomass gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies biomass to syngas, shifts and cleans it to hydrogen and synthesises ammonia.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Ethylene from lignocellulosic gasification
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; Material Economics 2019; Negri 2021
description: Gasifies lignocellulosic biomass to syngas and converts it to ethylene (via methanol-to-olefins or Fischer-Tropsch).

label: Biomass or waste gasification to methanol
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; Agora Energiewende 2021; etsap_2013_007
description: Gasifies biomass or waste to syngas, then synthesizes methanol.

label: Coal gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies coal with oxygen, shifts and cleans the syngas and synthesises ammonia.
note: About 36 GJ/t and 3.2 t CO2/t against 28 GJ/t and 1.8 t for steam reforming (IEA 2021). No Canadian stock. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Coal gasification to methanol
description: Coal or lignite gasification and synthesis to methanol: 58-72 GJ/t against 33-37 for gas reforming, about 5 t CO2/t.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Nitric acid oxidation adipic acid plant
description: Cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone oxidized with nitric acid, releasing N2O in the off-gas.

label: Ammonium nitrate and CAN plant
description: Neutralisation of nitric acid with ammonia, evaporation and prilling or granulation (AN, CAN, ANS); can export steam.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Anthraquinone hydrogen peroxide plant
description: Hydrogenation and air oxidation of an anthraquinone working solution, with extraction and distillation of hydrogen peroxide.

label: Catalytic N2O abatement
sources: Boulamanti 2017; LVIC-AAF BREF 2007; EPA 2010 nitric acid; Pérez-Ramírez 2003
description: Secondary or tertiary catalyst destroying N2O in nitric and adipic acid plants.
note: Abates process emissions rather than energy.

label: Chemical depolymerization
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Singh 2021; Uekert et al 2023
description: Depolymerizes PET or polystyrene back to monomer.

label: CO2-to-methanol
sources: IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; Material Economics 2019; etsap_2013_007
description: Hydrogenates captured CO2 to methanol, directly or through reverse water-gas shift.

label: Bio-ethanol dehydration to ethylene
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Boulamanti 2017; Negri 2021; IEA 2013; etsap_2013_009
description: Dehydrates ethanol to ethylene, bypassing cracking.

label: Ethylene oxide and glycol plant
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; LVOC BREF 2017; Saygin 2011; Neelis 2008; doe_2015_004
description: Silver-catalysed oxidation of ethylene to ethylene oxide, with hydration to ethylene glycol; separates a nearly pure CO2 stream.
note: The by-product CO2 is concentrated (capture needs only drying and compression). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Ethylene oxide reactor with capture of the process CO2
description: An ethylene oxide plant whose concentrated by-product CO2 from the scrubber is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen Haber-Bosch
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; LVIC-AAF BREF 2007; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; Material Economics 2019; Rouwenhorst 2019; Smith et al 2020; iea_2021_001
description: Electrolysis replaces the reformer; synthesis is unchanged.
note: Merged reactor_haber-bosch-low-pressure (Low-pressure Haber-Bosch) 2026-10-02 [C26, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 5, product-unit t.

label: Haber-Bosch synthesis loop with air separation (component)
sources: Armijo and Philibert 2020; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; Rouwenhorst 2019
description: The ammonia synthesis loop and nitrogen supply, priced without the hydrogen plant.

label: Methanol to olefins
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA 2018a; Boulamanti 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; Material Economics 2019; IEA 2013
description: Converts methanol to ethylene and propylene over a zeolite catalyst.

label: Ammonia oxidation nitric acid plant
sources: UKERC 2013; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; LVIC-AAF BREF 2007; EPA 2010 nitric acid; Pérez-Ramírez 2003; doe_2015_004
description: Ostwald process: ammonia burned over platinum gauze and the gases absorbed in water; the reaction heat raises export steam.

label: Plastics pyrolysis recycling
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Agora Energiewende 2021; Negri 2021; Riedewald 2021; Solis 2020
description: Pyrolyzes mixed plastic waste to a cracker feedstock.

label: Polymerization reactor and extrusion
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; Saygin 2011; POL BREF 2007; Neelis 2008; Negri 2021; doe_2015_004
description: Reactor trains and extruders making polymers and compounds.

note: Bucket: DOE state-of-the-art tiers 21-83% below current typical (HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC, PET, PC, PS). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Syngas methanol synthesis
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; Saygin 2011; doe_2015_004; etsap_2013_007
description: Reformed gas converted to methanol over a copper catalyst.

label: Thermal N2O destruction
description: Adipic acid off-gas burned or thermally decomposed, destroying N2O and raising steam from the heat.
note: Abates process emissions rather than energy.

label: Urea synthesis and finishing
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; Saygin 2011; LVIC-AAF BREF 2007; doe_2015_004
description: Reacts ammonia with CO2 from the ammonia plant to urea, with prilling or granulation.
note: Consumes ammonia-plant process CO2 (about 0.73 t CO2/t urea), which matters to ammonia capture accounting. Serves chemicals.product.urea, added to the snapshot 2026-09-30. Added 2026-09-25. Merged reactor_urea-total-recycle (Total-recycle (non-stripping) urea plant) 2026-10-02 [C27, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Catalytic cracking of naphtha
description: Catalysis lowers the cracking temperature against a thermal cracker.

label: Steam cracker with capture on the furnace flue gas
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals
description: A steam cracker whose cracking-furnace flue gas, from numerous dilute stacks, is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Oxy-fuel cracking (iea_2024_001 row 226, TRL 5) concentrates it instead. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Electrified cracker furnace
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Agora Energiewende 2021; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; Layritz et al 2021; Mynko 2023
description: Electric heating of the cracking coils in place of burners.
examples-named: BASF, SABIC and Linde demonstration at Ludwigshafen (4 t/h, 6 MW, 2024); Rotodynamic cracking reactor
note: Merged steam-cracker_rotodynamic (Rotodynamic cracking reactor) 2026-10-02 [C25, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t.

sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA 2018a; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; LVOC BREF 2017; Saygin 2011; Agora Energiewende 2021; Neelis 2008; IEA 2013; Layritz et al 2021; Mynko 2023; Talaei 2018; doe_2015_004
description: Hydrocarbon feed cracked in fired tubular coils, then quenched and separated.

note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on steam-cracker_fired-tubular.

label: Steam reforming with Haber-Bosch synthesis
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA 2018a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Boulamanti 2017; Saygin 2011; Agora Energiewende 2021; LVIC-AAF BREF 2007; Material Economics 2019; IEA 2013; Rouwenhorst 2019; Smith et al 2020; Talaei 2018; doe_2015_004; iea_2021_001
description: Reformed natural gas feeds ammonia synthesis at pressure.

label: Ammonia plant with capture on the process CO2
sources: Bataille 2017; Boulamanti 2017; Kearns 2021; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; Material Economics 2019; etsap_2010_007; iea_2021_001
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 347 (partial capture); row 346 gives 6 for full capture
description: An ammonia plant whose CO2 removal step ahead of synthesis sends its pure process CO2 to capture instead of venting it; part of that CO2 is already sold for urea. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. This is the cheapest capture in the sector and should not be averaged with flue-gas capture. Full capture needs a second, dilute plant on the reformer flue gas. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Ammonia plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice reforming, synthesis and heat integration in an ammonia plant, saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state of the art 46% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Pressure or vacuum swing adsorption
description: Adsorbent beds separating CO2 from hydrogen-plant syngas.

label: Advanced low-energy solvent
description: Second-generation solvents cutting reboiler duty against first-generation MEA.

label: Amine post-combustion capture
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Habert et al 2020; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; Leeson et al 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; CSI-ECRA 2017; DEA 2024 CCTS; IEAGHG 2013; IEAGHG 2016; Voldsund 2019; Hughes 2023; IEA-CSI 2018; Kearns 2021; DOE 2023 Liftoff cement; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; Draxler 2021; Hasanbeigi 2013; IEAGHG 2018; Kuparinen 2019; Onarheim et al 2017a; Onarheim et al 2017b; etsap_2010_007; iea_2021_001; netl_2022_001
description: Absorbs CO2 from flue gas into an amine solvent; steam strips it back out.
examples-named: Boundary Dam (Cansolv); Entropy Glacier; Brevik cement; Solid sorbent capture; Calcium looping
note: TRL 9 in power, 7-8 on cement kilns. Merged capture-unit_solid-sorbent (Solid sorbent capture) 2026-10-02 [C36, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 6, product-unit t. Merged capture-unit_calcium-looping (Calcium looping) 2026-10-02 [C36, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type prospective, trl 7, product-unit t.

label: Chemical solvent on process gas
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Leeson et al 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEAGHG 2013; Hughes 2023; Kearns 2021; netl_2022_001
description: Amine absorption on shifted syngas or acid gas, then regeneration.

label: Cryogenic separation
description: Condenses CO2 from a pressurized stream at low temperature.

description: Chills flue gas so CO2 desublimates or condenses out.

label: Liquid-solvent DAC

description: Alkaline solution captures CO2; a high-temperature calciner regenerates it.

label: Solid-sorbent DAC

description: Sorbent beds cycled at low temperature, suited to waste heat and modular build.
examples-named: Climeworks; Deep Sky Alpha (Innisfail, Alberta, operating since August 2025)

label: Physical solvent
description: Selexol or Rectisol absorption at pressure on gasifier syngas.

label: Dehydration and compression

description: Dries and compresses an already pure CO2 stream for transport.

description: Newer engine and compressor with lower fuel use per unit of compression.

description: Large motors driving centrifugal compressors on grid power.

description: Motor-driven reciprocating compressors in place of gas engines.

label: Flare gas recovery
description: Compresses gas that would be flared back into the fuel or sales line.

label: Reciprocating gas-engine compressor
description: Engine-driven reciprocating compressors, common on gathering systems and at gas plants.

label: Instrument air or electric actuation
description: Compressed air or electric actuators and pumps replace gas-driven devices.

label: Vapour recovery unit
description: Compresses tank and process vapours back into the sales line.

label: Fired line heater and treater
description: Burner heating produced fluids to break emulsions and prevent hydrates.

label: Battery hybrid rig power
description: Battery smooths engine load, cutting fuel and run hours.

label: Diesel drilling rig
description: Diesel-electric rig powering the drawworks, mud pumps and camp.

label: Grid-powered or electric rig
description: Rig drawing from the grid or a field electrical system.

label: Evaporators and crystallizers
description: Mechanical vapour recompression evaporators producing distilled makeup and a small residual for disposal.

label: Flare with continuous pilot
description: Elevated flare burning solution and process gas that is not captured; the incumbent disposal route.

label: Enclosed combustor
description: Enclosed burner destroying tank and process vapours that would otherwise be vented.
note: Destroys vented gas, so release and destruction compete inside this end use.

label: High-efficiency flare
description: Air-assisted or improved flare tips raising destruction efficiency and cutting unburnt methane.
note: Abates the methane slip from an ordinary flare, not the flaring itself.

label: Electric fracturing fleet
description: Electric pumps on grid or turbine power replace diesel pump spreads.

label: Glycol dehydration
description: TEG contactor with a fired reboiler regenerating the glycol.

description: Recovers turbine exhaust heat for process and utility duties.

description: Modular trains for peak shaving and remote supply.

label: Drag-reducing agents
description: Polymer injection cuts friction, raising throughput per unit of pumping power.

examples-named: bellows-sealed valves; low-e packing; welded connections

label: Electric artificial lift
description: Beam pumps, progressive-cavity and electric submersible pumps on motors.

label: Electric pump station
description: Motor-driven mainline pumps moving crude and products.

label: Plunger lift and smart liquids unloading
description: Unloads liquids without blowing the well down to atmosphere.

label: Variable-speed pump drives
description: Speed control replaces throttling and station cycling.

label: Ebullated-bed hydrocracking
description: Hydrogen addition in a moving catalyst bed for high conversion of residue.

label: Fluid or flexi-coking
description: Fluidized thermal cracking, with the coke partly gasified for fuel gas.

description: Hydrogen treating to remove sulphur and stabilize synthetic crude.

description: Engine-driven pumps on lines without grid supply.

label: Sulphur recovery and acid gas removal
description: Amine treating plus a Claus unit and tail-gas treatment.
note: Merged gas-treatment-unit_claus (Claus sulphur recovery) 2026-10-02 [C10, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit m3.

label: Coal or petroleum-coke gasification
sources: IEA 2019f; REF BREF 2015; Boulamanti 2017; Worrell 2015; etsap_2010_011; etsap_2014_003
description: Partial oxidation of solid feed to syngas, then shift.

label: Advanced heat integration
description: Pinch-designed preheat train and better fouling control, cutting furnace duty.

label: Alkylation and isomerization
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; REF BREF 2015; Worrell 2015; doe_2015_002
description: Combines or rearranges light ends into high-octane blendstock.

label: Catalytic reforming
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; REF BREF 2015; Worrell 2015; doe_2015_002
description: Upgrades naphtha to high-octane reformate, producing hydrogen.

label: Delayed coking
description: Thermally cracks residue to lighter products and petroleum coke.

label: Fluid catalytic cracking
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; REF BREF 2015; Boulamanti 2017; Worrell 2015; doe_2015_002
description: Cracks gas oil over a circulating catalyst; coke burnt off in the regenerator supplies the heat.

label: Oxy-fuel FCC regeneration
description: Burns catalyst coke in oxygen so the regenerator flue gas is CO2-rich.
note: Oxy-firing the regenerator concentrates the stream: capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated.

label: FCC regenerator with post-combustion capture
sources: DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; Worrell 2015
description: A fluid catalytic cracker whose regenerator flue gas, the largest single stack in a refinery, is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Oxy-fuel regeneration is its own row and gives a concentrated stream. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Hydroprocessing (hydrocracking and hydrotreating)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; REF BREF 2015; Worrell 2015; doe_2015_002
description: Hydrogen-driven cracking and sulphur or nitrogen removal at pressure.

label: Visbreaker
description: Mild thermal cracking of residue in a coil or soaker without coke make: 400-800 MJ/t fuel against 800-1200 for delayed coking.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Conversion (cracking) refinery (whole plant)
description: A hydroskimming refinery with catalytic cracking or hydrocracking.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Deep-conversion (coking) refinery (whole plant)
description: A conversion refinery with coking or residue hydrocracking, able to run heavy crude and bitumen blends.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Hydroskimming refinery (whole plant)
description: Distillation, reforming and hydrotreating with no conversion units.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Reformer efficiency measures, moderate
description: Heat integration and feed conditioning on an existing reformer.
examples-named: pre-reforming; convection-section heat recovery; combustion-air preheat; hydrogen recovery from purge gas
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ).

label: Steam methane reformer
sources: IEA 2019f; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; REF BREF 2015; Boulamanti 2017; Agora Energiewende 2021; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; doe_2015_004; doe_2022_001; etsap_2014_003
description: Reforms natural gas with steam, then shifts to hydrogen and CO2.

label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the shift gas
sources: IEA 2019f; IPCC 2022; Philibert 2017a; Boulamanti 2017; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; DOE 2025 Liftoff chemicals; doe_2022_001
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 285 (partial capture); row 284 gives 6 for high capture rates
description: A steam methane reformer whose shifted syngas, where the CO2 is already at high partial pressure, is sent to capture. Taking the reformer flue gas as well would also need the diffuse capture service. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
note: [refinery-hydrogen] Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Partial capture takes only the shift gas and reaches about 60% of the plant total; full capture adds a diffuse-stream plant on the reformer flue gas. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Anaerobic treatment with biogas recovery
description: Anaerobic reactors on high-strength streams, cutting aeration load and recovering biogas as fuel.
note: Turns part of the treatment load into a fuel, which is why it is a technology choice rather than generic pumping.

label: Recovery boiler
sources: IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Kramer 2009; Larson 2006; US 2010; Fleiter 2012; Hamaguchi 2012; Kong 2016; Kuparinen 2019; Lipiainen 2022; Vakkilainen 2006
description: Burns concentrated black liquor, recovering smelt and raising high-pressure steam.

label: High-solids firing and high-pressure recovery boiler
description: Higher liquor dry solids and steam conditions, raising power and steam yield.

label: Recovery boiler with post-combustion capture
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 422; row 501 gives 6 for post-combustion capture on biomass combustion
description: A recovery boiler whose stack gas is sent to capture. The CO2 is biogenic, so this is a removal rather than an avoided emission. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. The mill steam balance is what binds, and that is the host-side fact this row carries. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Batch kraft digester with displacement heating
description: Batch cooking with hot-liquor displacement recovering most of the cooking heat.

label: Continuous kraft digester
sources: IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; ETSAP I07; Owttrim 2022; doe_2015_003
description: Continuous vessel cooking chips in white liquor, with heat recovery from the flash steam.

label: Deep eutectic solvent pulping
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; Institute for Sustainable Proc 2018
description: Separates lignin from cellulose with deep eutectic solvents at low temperature and pressure instead of kraft cooking.

label: Semi-chemical and sulphite pulping
description: Milder chemical cooking for corrugating medium and specialty pulps.

label: Sulphite chemical pulping
description: Acid or neutral sulphite cooking with its own liquor recovery chemistry; legacy Canadian sulphite and dissolving-pulp mills.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Electric air heating
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Electric heaters replace the gas burner on hoods and air dryers.

label: Gas-fired hood, infrared or air dryer
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Direct-fired Yankee hoods, infrared and air dryers on tissue and coating.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t water evaporated or t product).

label: Heat-pump drying
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Heat pump upgrades dryer exhaust heat back into the drying air.

label: Market pulp dryer
sources: IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002
description: Airborne or cylinder dryer for market pulp sheets; about a quarter of a kraft mill's heat.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Steam-heated cylinder dryer section
product: t water evaporated or t product
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; Kramer 2009; Ager 2023; Ciambellotti 2024; Fleiter 2012; Kong 2016; doe_2015_003
description: Steam-filled cans drying the web, with condensate return.

label: Paper dryer section efficiency measures, moderate
product: t water evaporated or t product
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; Kramer 2009; Owttrim 2022
description: The steam-heated cylinder dryer section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: reduced air infiltration, hood humidity, pressure and felt optimisation, condensate return, flash-steam use, low-pressure steam, heat recovery (UKERC PP-D1 to PP-D11); High-efficiency hood with heat recovery
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_steam-heated. Merged dryer_hood-heat-recovery (High-efficiency hood with heat recovery) 2026-10-02 [C13, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Paper dryer section efficiency measures, strong
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: The steam-heated cylinder dryer section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: hot press ahead of the dryer section (UKERC PP-D12)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_steam-heated.

label: Through-air (TAD) tissue dryer
description: Through-air drying of premium tissue, roughly two to three times the energy of Yankee drying.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Multiple-effect evaporators
sources: IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; doe_2015_003
description: Concentrates weak black liquor in a train of effects on live steam.

label: Activated sludge aeration
description: Surface aerators or coarse-bubble diffusers holding an aeration basin at the oxygen demand of the effluent.

label: Fine-bubble diffused aeration
description: Fine-bubble diffusers with blower control on dissolved oxygen, at a fraction of the power of surface aeration.

label: Black liquor gasification
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; PP BREF 2015; ETSAP I07; Kramer 2009; Larson 2006; US 2010; Hamaguchi 2012; Kong 2016; Owttrim 2022; Vakkilainen 2006; etsap_2013_007
description: Gasifies liquor to syngas for fuels, chemicals or a gas turbine, in place of a recovery boiler.

label: Electrified lime kiln
description: Plasma or electric heating of the calcination zone.

label: Biomass-gasifier-fired lime kiln
sources: PP BREF 2015; Hamaguchi 2012; Kuparinen and Vakkilainen 2017; Owttrim 2022
description: On-site gasifier supplies producer gas to the kiln burner in place of fossil fuel.

label: Lime kiln with product cooler and improved drying
description: Better cooler, chain section and mud drying, cutting fuel per tonne of lime.

label: Rotary lime kiln
sources: IPCC 2022; IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; CLM BREF 2013; PP BREF 2015; FPInnovations 2026; Kuparinen 2019; Owttrim 2022; Svensson et al 2021; doe_2015_003
description: Calcines lime mud back to lime for causticizing.

label: Fourdrinier or gap former with press section
sources: Bataille 2017; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; ETSAP I07; Kramer 2009; US 2010; doe_2015_003
description: Headbox, wire and press section dewatering the sheet mechanically.

label: Paper machine efficiency measures, moderate
description: The fourdrinier or gap former with press section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: wire-section drainage and vacuum practice, felt and press steam optimisation, online moisture management (UKERC PP-W, PP-P3, PP-P7, PP-VWPD1)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for wire- and press-section measures.

label: Paper machine press section efficiency measures, strong
description: The fourdrinier or gap former with press section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: steam boxes ahead of the press (UKERC PP-P2)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on paper-machine_fourdrinier-gap.

label: Paper making without water
description: Forms paper by dry or foam forming, removing most of the water that the dryer section must evaporate.

label: Advanced mechanical dewatering
description: Impulse or pressurized dewatering removing more water before the dryers.

label: Shoe (extended-nip) press
sources: UKERC 2013; PP BREF 2015; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; Kramer 2009
description: Longer nip raises sheet dryness into the dryer section, cutting drying steam.

label: Drum debarker and disc chipper
sources: Bataille 2017; IEAGHG 2016; Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015
description: A rotating drum strips bark by tumbling the logs; disc chippers cut them to chips for screening.

label: Log and chip thawing with recovered heat
description: Warm water or low-grade waste heat thaws frozen wood in place of live steam.

label: Chemi-thermomechanical pulping
description: Mild chemical pre-treatment before refining, at lower electricity per tonne.

label: Stone or pressure groundwood
sources: Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Kramer 2009
description: Grinding logs against a stone (GW, PGW); legacy mechanical pulp with little steam recovery.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Recycled-fibre repulping and deinking
sources: Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; ETSAP I07; Kramer 2009; US 2010; Fleiter 2012; Kong 2016; Lipiainen 2022
description: Pulpers, screens and flotation cells recovering fibre from recovered paper.

label: Low-energy refining
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA ETP Guide 2024; PP BREF 2015; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial; Owttrim 2022
description: Advanced segments, RTS conditions or pre-treatment cutting refiner electricity.

label: Thermomechanical pulping refiners
sources: Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; ETSAP I07; Kramer 2009; Fleiter 2012
description: Steam-pressurized disc refiners fibrillating chips; refiner heat is recovered as steam.

label: Conventional ECF bleach plant
sources: Natural Resources Canada 2008; PP BREF 2015; doe_2015_003
description: Elemental-chlorine-free bleaching sequence with chlorine dioxide stages, without oxygen delignification.
note: Conventional host for reactor_oxygen-delignification. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Oxygen delignification with ECF bleaching
sources: IEAGHG 2016; PP BREF 2015; Francis 2002; Owttrim 2022; doe_2015_003
description: Removes lignin with oxygen before bleaching, cutting chemical and steam use.

label: Clarification and sludge dewatering
description: Primary clarifiers with belt or screw presses, and dryers where the sludge is burnt.
note: product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ).

label: Lignin extraction
sources: ETSAP I07; Hamaguchi 2012; Kong 2016; Kuparinen and Vakkilainen 2017; Kuparinen 2019
description: Precipitates lignin from the liquor as a fuel or chemical feedstock, debottlenecking the boiler.

label: Membrane bioreactor effluent treatment
description: Activated sludge with submerged membranes replacing the clarifier; about twice the energy of conventional activated sludge.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Mechanical vapour recompression evaporation
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DOE 2023 Liftoff industrial
description: Recompresses vapour to drive the evaporator, replacing most live steam with electricity.
examples-named: Caustic evaporation with mechanical vapour recompression
note: Merged vapour-recompressor_caustic-evaporation (Caustic evaporation with mechanical vapour recompression) 2026-10-02 [C12, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Chilled-water system
description: Central chiller serving air handlers through chilled water.
examples-named: Packaged air conditioner or rooftop unit
note: Merged chiller_packaged (Packaged air conditioner or rooftop unit) 2026-10-02 [C32, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit GJ.

label: Free or evaporative cooling
description: Uses ambient air or evaporation before running the refrigeration cycle.

label: Constant-volume fan system
description: Supply and exhaust fans running at fixed flow.
note: Building ventilation.

label: Variable-speed fans
description: Fan speed follows the load instead of throttling or running flat out.
note: Building ventilation.

label: Reversible heat pump
description: One machine providing both building heat and cooling.

label: Space-heating heat pump
description: Air-source or ground-source heat pump for building heat and cooling.

label: Electric resistance space heating
description: Unit heaters and baseboards.

label: Fuel-fired space or make-up air heater
description: Unit heaters, radiant tubes and make-up air units firing gas.

label: Demand-controlled ventilation
description: Air flow set by occupancy or contaminant sensing.
note: Building ventilation. Merged ventilation-unit_mine-on-demand (Ventilation on demand) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Heat-recovery ventilation
description: Exhaust air preheats or precools the incoming supply air.
note: Building ventilation. Merged heat-recovery-unit_exhaust-air (Exhaust-air heat recovery) 2026-10-02 [C33, docs/archetype-combination-review-2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 7, product-unit GJ.
